newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Feb 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Feb 18.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (822) 727-5649. Fax: (822) 727-5666.
- North Korea on Monday showed signs it may allow Hwang Jang-yop, a high-ranking North Korean official to defect to South Korea.
- Police have identified handgun shells used in the murder attempt on prominent North Korean defector, Li Il-nam, as made in Czechoslovakia.
- An extraordinary session of the National Assembly was convened on Monday to discuss controversial legislation including the new labour law.
- Business leaders suggested in a meeting on Monday they may accept the existence of multiple unions on a conditional basis.
